milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task where the player must navigate toward and observe the red nether brick wall structure. The target is the center of the 3×3 red nether brick wall at spawn-relative (7, 2, 7). max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' it from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wall (not facing away). This correctly models 'player can see the target object'.
